[Ginger1] Hi, how much for a FoxESS KH10, FoxESS CQ7-
50-L6 without rebates? Single phase
Also is it worth going for a battery with warming function in VIC?
[ENERFORGE PTY LTD] Hi,
I'd actually recommend going with the latest FoxESS battery model, which comes with active heating.
This is particularly important in Melbourne, where winter temperatures can get quite low. The older Fox CQ6 batteries don't have active heating, which can significantly affect charging performance during cold weather.
Personally, I think batteries are like electronics — it's generally better to go with the latest generation, especially when it offers meaningful improvements.
For reference, the latest FoxESS 49kWh battery system would cost around $18k installed without rebate, depending on site conditions.
[Ginger1] Thanks. I had to double check.
I am after a maximum ~42kwh battery, on the newer battery is that EQ5500-L8? If so what is the price for that?
I am still interested in the price for the older 42kwh battery CQ7-50-L6.
Thank you for the quick response.
